raised_because: DECISION_RULE_dl_program_book_gate_2026-09-25.md revision 4 (commit 8d82c31b1) carries the header claim 'written before any T3 book-layer reading'. The timestamps contradict that claim.

timeline_utc.event: the three T3 book-layer cells finished
dlarch committed the T3 readings (per-seed dbar, both columns, sd(d))
dlarch sent lead the per-seed double-column table and sd(d)
timeline_utc.evidence: message titled 'T3 3/3 done: T3 is WORSE than T0 and than NC in 2026 (-1.418 / -3.015); sd(d) verified by two agreeing routes'

gap: revision 4 postdates the delivery of the readings by about 5.5 hours

why_it_matters_substantively.change: revision 4 moves the MAIN criterion from the pre-2026 segment to the 2026 segment
why_it_matters_substantively.effect_on_the_verdict: the two segments give qualitatively DIFFERENT outcomes for T3, so the choice of window is outcome-relevant

original_section_3_pre2026.reading: |d| is 4.8% of the floor -> NO RESOLUTION

revision_4_2026.reading: all three conditions fail -> DECISIVE REJECT

why_it_matters_substantively.summary: switching the main window turns 'cannot be resolved' into 'clearly rejected'

disclosures.direction_of_bias: the change is AGAINST dlarch's own arm. Both readings reject T3; revision 4 only makes the rejection harder. This alert brings dlarch no benefit, which is stated so the alert is not read as advocacy for a looser gate.
disclosures.who_should_judge: NOT dlarch. dlarch has a stake in what this gate admits, so whether revision 4 still stands is lead's determination, per the project rule that a criterion must not be authored or adjudicated by a party with an interest in what it admits.
benign_explanations_that_remain_open: the user's ruling may have been formed independently of dlarch's readings
the message may have been unread in lead's queue when revision 4 was written
either way the falsifiable header claim is now falsified and needs correcting, because a later reader would otherwise believe this gate was written blind

arithmetic_verified_independently.note: under revision 4 the backstop branch is 6.8x the measured branch, because sd(d_2026) is only 0.158. The 'backstop always binds' observation raised on 2026-09-25 is therefore MORE extreme in the 2026 segment, not less.

action_withheld: dlarch will not implement the verdict device under revision 4 until lead disposes of this timeline, because coding it would freeze a criterion whose authorship is unresolved into the instrument.
